name: ITRONIC
recent: Industronics 近期出现股东要求召开特别股东大会以撤换执行主席、董事经理等四人，涉及一笔 460 万美元的贷款争议；公司质疑该 EGM 通知的有效性，称相关指控尚未证实。公司同时处于 PN17 财务困境公司的每月公告阶段，且大股东 Hexatech Energy 与 Datuk Wira Yong Chong Cheang 近期多次申报股权变动。
notable: 股东要求召开特别股东大会，以撤换执行主席、董事经理 Leong 等四人。
公司就 460 万美元 Bluemount Investment Fund SPC 贷款交易作出澄清，称相关指控尚未证实且正进行法律程序。
公司质疑该 EGM 通知的有效性，指部分股东持股低于 10% 门槛。
risks: 公司处于 PN17 财务困境类别，需按月发布公告。
大股东 Hexatech Energy 与 Datuk Wira Yong Chong Cheang 近期多次申报股权变动。
涉及 460 万美元贷款的法律争议及股东要求撤换董事的 EGM 带来治理不确定性。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间营收为 MYR 218,792，同比下滑 90.7%；净亏损 MYR 1,307,297，净利率为 -597.5%。

recent_en: Industronics recently saw shareholders requisition an EGM to remove the executive chairman, managing director and two others, tied to a US$4.6 million loan dispute; the company is questioning the validity of the EGM notice and says the claims are unproven. The company is also in the monthly announcement phase under PN17 and has seen repeated shareholding change filings by major shareholder Hexatech Energy and Datuk Wira Yong Chong Cheang.
notable_en: Shareholders have requisitioned an EGM to remove the executive chairman, managing director Leong and two others.
The company clarified the US$4.6 million loan transaction with Bluemount Investment Fund SPC, saying the claims are unproven and subject to ongoing legal proceedings.
The company is questioning the validity of the EGM notice, saying certain shareholders' stake is below the 10% threshold.
risks_en: The company is under PN17 financial distress classification and must issue monthly announcements.
Major shareholder Hexatech Energy and Datuk Wira Yong Chong Cheang have made repeated shareholding change filings recently.
The US$4.6 million loan legal dispute and the EGM seeking to remove directors create governance uncertainty.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 218,792, down 90.7% year-on-year; net loss was MYR 1,307,297 with a net margin of -597.5%.
